name: attribution-statT
cmd: set -e; for spec in desk_tempho_1995_s1_statT:E038/desk-tempho1995-seed1-statT-073c34187ddb:desk_tempho_1995_seed1 desk_tempho_1995_s2_statT:E038/desk-tempho1995-seed2-statT-e7e26da6a899:desk_tempho_1995_seed2 desk_tempho_1985_s1_statT:E038/desk-tempho1985-seed1-statT-0de857c2b8e1:desk_tempho_1985_seed1 desk_tempho_1985_s2_statT:E038/desk-tempho1985-seed2-statT-dee3cbeac21f:desk_tempho_1985_seed2; do IFS=: read -r cc run ov <<< "$spec"; {python} research/exp/static_channels.py --channels temperature --means-cache {outroot}/$run/static_means.npy -- research/exp/backcast_attribution.py --cache {cache}/$cc --run-dir {outroot}/$run/desk --overlay research/overlays/$ov.json --out {out}/$cc --families --luh-split; done
summarize: for d in {out}/*/; do {python} research/exp/backcast_attribution.py --summarize $d; done
note: E038 measure (1): backcast attribution of the static-temperature models (encoded under the same static temperature they were trained with); controls = E035e
